en: Colorized vintage street view of a European town. The scene shows a wide, clean street lined with multi-story brick and stone buildings in late 19th- / early 20th-century style. In the distance stands a church or town hall tower with an onion-shaped dome and clock. People in long dresses, hats, and early 1900s attire walk along the sidewalks. At the top of the image, printed text reads "Döbeln i. Sa." on the left and "Königsstrasse." on the right.
